payload.body: FREEZE for hv's 0.1.9 cut. hv, 2026-10-07: "P0 is getting the devbin release shipped." This is the durable copy of vc's SendMessage. Until vc's all-clear, write nothing in the devbin tree. That means no intent wb verb at all, a pickup included, and no commit, no file and no issues or st write. Leave this message live, with no wb clear, until the all-clear. Do not /compact; if you have to, read your board with wb show rather than pickup. Start no heavy run while the cut's gates run, and reply by SendMessage. The cut's pre-flight refuses a dirty tree, and its step 5 re-reads the tree after the gates and fails on any change, a heartbeat included. The dry run hv ran on 2026-10-06 predicted every step, with its gates green on 58d837ac: check's five seals empty, and the suite at 1..2205 with 2205 ok.
